entities.name: PMID:31691064
observations: Retrospective single-center study at Chiba University Hospital, Japan, evaluating 297 ICD leads implanted from March 2008 through September 2017.
Compared three lead groups: Durata (n=105), Linox/LinoxSmart (n=66), and Sprint Quattro (n=126).

entities.name: Durata ICD lead
observations: Failure rate was 0.20% per patient-year; five-year survival was 98.9%; mean follow-up was 4.8 years.

entities.name: Linox/LinoxSmart ICD lead
observations: Failure rate was 0.95% per patient-year; five-year survival was 100%; mean follow-up was 6.4 years.

entities.name: Sprint Quattro ICD lead
observations: Failure rate was 1.84% per patient-year; five-year survival was 87.5%; mean follow-up was 3.0 years.
Survival was lower than Durata (log-rank p=0.011) and Linox/LinoxSmart (p=0.028); comparison with Durata versus Linox/LinoxSmart was not significant (p=0.393).
